caption: A top-to-bottom view of the DO-178B V-model: requirements move down from aircraft level to high-level requirements, low-level requirements and code; verification follows through unit test, integration test and validation. The two blue boxes are the code and the unit test.

spec.title: DO-178B V-model (top-to-bottom view)
spec.aria: Flow from aircraft requirements down through high-level and low-level requirements and code, then to unit test, integration test and validation.
